title: Contrix Agent Task
description: Object schema for cx.schema.agent_task.v1 (mirror Space task). State lives in three orthogonal FSM cells (execution_state / transparency / source_authority), NOT in object schema fields. See spec/v1/zh/extensions/agent-workspace-profile.md §7.

space_id.description: Mirror Space ID. MUST be a Space declaring cx.profile.agent_workspace.v1.

target_agent_id.description: Agent DID that will execute this task. MUST be a controller-owned agent (cx.schema.agent_authority.v1 controller == workspace owner).

instruction.description: Content block describing the task. Same shape as cx.content.* block.

context_anchor.description: Optional binding to a source Space frontier when this task is triggered by a mention_redirect in source Space.

source_stub_event_ref.description: Set after Phase 3 reconcile to reference the source Space mention_redirect event. Single-sided audit anchor; source Space does not store reverse reference.

$comment: State is NOT stored as object fields. Read execution_state / transparency / source_authority FSM cells via lattice query. Schema validation only checks shape; reducer enforces FSM transitions per spec/v1/zh/extensions/agent-workspace-profile.md §7.
